image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of an adult common iguana (Iguana iguana). The subject displays characteristic features including a prominent dorsal crest with spine-like scales, a large subtympanic shield below the ear, and textured, granular skin. The coloration is primarily brownish-grey with hints of orange on the crest, suggesting an adult male or specific morph rather than a bright green juvenile. The background consists of a blurred, light-colored wall and a ledge.
